cart_only_bans.label: Senoia Code Sec. 66-103: no motorized carts on State Highway 16 (Wells Street) or State Highway 85 except authorized crossings

unverified: State Route 16 is tagged Wells Street in OpenStreetMap. Broad Street is a separate 25 mph city street and is not part of this ban.

enforcement.note: Golf Cart Maps Greenwich and next-10 research (Oct 28 2026). Posted signs never lift a ban. Designated street lists that are not digitized stay red for plain golf carts.
